name: EZ-Link Pte Ltd

scam_info.notes: EZ-Link 'Scam Notice' (updated 31 Jan 2024) found via web search; now returns 404. Per search snippet only - unverified: it told customers to check that website links belong to the official EZ-Link domain (ending with ezlink.com.sg).

notes: https://www.ezlink.com.sg/ now 301-redirects to https://ezlink.simplygo.com.sg/ (EZ-Link folded under the SimplyGo brand; SimplyGo is LTA/TransitLink = quasi-government, no record here per instructions). blocked: ezlink.simplygo.com.sg returns HTTP 403 Forbidden (Apache) to curl and to WebFetch for the homepage; robots.txt 404 - not bypassed, so no on-site content verified. official_domains (b): ezlink.com.sg is the legacy official domain that redirects to the SimplyGo-hosted site; simplygo.com.sg not added (government-side). Context from web search - unverified (search snippet): SPF advisories (Mar 2025: >=97 reports / >=S$156,000; Sep 2025: >=S$59,000 since 1 Aug) on fake social-media ads for cheap/unlimited-travel EZ-Link cards leading to phishing sites; 'All promotions for EZ-Link cards are conducted only on SimplyGo websites and the social media pages of SimplyGo and EZ-Link'; SimplyGo hotline 1800-2255-663. SPF brand tag 'SimplyGo' relates.
